paragraphs: This computationally generated zine is one of one, out of many, made for visitors to the opening night of "Ephemera Eternal: and invasions on DIY spaces...". No other copy is like this one. Its text is drawn from the non-combinatorial vocabulary of keywords "gentrification" and "Uncle Lou's," scraped from 311 articles in the Orlando Weekly and the Orlando Sentinel.

Uncle Lou ran a dive bar in Orlando, FL. For nearly two decades, Uncle Lou's Entertainment Hall was home to local musicians and artists. Following Lou's deportation in Summer 2026, Adam Goldman and The AWG Foundation responded by exhibiting photographs and old flyers, respectively. Ephemera Eternal raises money for the Lou's staff displaced when the venue shut down.
Many of us would not exist as we do without Lou.
